name: Commonworld Atlas link safety report

sources.name: Google Safe Browsing
sources.covers: malware, unwanted software, social engineering (phishing, deceptive pages)
sources.terms: Public Transparency Report site status lookup, no key; we publish only our own per-domain verdict with a link to Google's page.

sources.name: MetaMask eth-phishing-detect
sources.covers: crypto phishing and wallet drainer sites (exact blacklist only; the fuzzy look-alike list is not used)
sources.terms: Open source (DBAD Public License, https://github.com/MetaMask/eth-phishing-detect/blob/main/LICENSE); attribution given.

sources.name: ScamSniffer scam-database
sources.covers: crypto scam and phishing domains (public list, published with a 7-day delay)

sources.name: CERT Polska Warning List
sources.covers: phishing and fraud domains confirmed by the Polish national CERT (updated around the clock)
sources.terms: Data usage policy (https://cert.pl/en/warning-list/): may be used by anyone for any purpose, including commercial.

rule: A domain is flagged when ANY one source flags it; every Atlas entry that links to a flagged domain is removed at once, with a public decision (who, reason, evidence). clean = at least one source answered and none flags it; no_data = no source could answer.
method: Every outbound host linked from the published Atlas data is checked daily by the Commonworld trust engine against every source listed under sources. Each host carries the answer of each source (verdict, checked_at, evidence_url).
